def solve(value, limit):
    deepest = 0
    stack = [(value, 0)]
    while stack:
        item, level = stack.pop()
        if isinstance(item, list):
            deepest = max(deepest, level)
            stack.extend([(x, level + 1) for x in item])
    return deepest <= limit
```
